aiInstructions:
Data value reference (use these exact strings when filtering):

PowerPlant.status: "Active"
PowerPlant.plant_type: "Wind Farm", "Solar Park", "Gas Power Plant"
PowerPlant.fuel_type: "Wind", "Solar", "Natural Gas"
PowerPlant.region: "Eastern Macedonia and Thrace", "South Aegean", "Thessaly", "Crete", "Attica", "Peloponnese"
PowerPlant.prefecture: "Evros", "Cyclades", "Larissa", "Heraklion", "East Attica", "Arcadia"

WindTurbine.status: "Active"
WindTurbine.manufacturer: "Vestas", "Siemens Gamesa", "Enercon"

SolarInverter.status: "Active"
SolarInverter.panel_type: "Monocrystalline", "Polycrystalline", "Thin Film"

Substation.status: "Active"
Substation.substation_type: "Onshore Transmission", "Island Distribution", "High Voltage Transmission", "Island Hub"

MaintenanceOrder.status: "Open", "In Progress", "Scheduled", "Completed"
MaintenanceOrder.priority: "Critical", "High", "Medium", "Low"
MaintenanceOrder.order_type: "Corrective", "Preventive", "Inspection"

Vessel.status (from real-time KQL cargo_status field): "Loaded", "Crew + spare parts" (and any state the simulator currently emits — query KQL VesselPositions for live values).
Vessel.vessel_type: "LNG Carrier", "Crew Transfer Vessel"

EmissionsRecord.compliance_status: "Compliant", "Near Limit"

Guidance:
- When a user asks about "operating" or "running" turbines/inverters/plants/substations, interpret as status == "Active".
- The Vessel entity reads destination, speed_knots, and status from the real-time KQL stream (VesselPositions). Other properties come from the Lakehouse seed table.
- Real-time telemetry (power_mw, wind_speed_ms, vibration_mm_s, irradiance_wm2, efficiency_pct, frequency_hz, load_mw, generation_mw, latitude, longitude, heading_deg, eta_hours) is in KQL.
- Static asset and reporting metadata (plant_name, capacity_mw, region, prefecture, commissioning_date, supply_plant_id, cost_eur, co2_tonnes, etc.) is in the Lakehouse.
- Use GROUP BY in GQL when aggregating.

Capacity vs Generation (CRITICAL):
- capacity_mw / capacity_kw = NAMEPLATE / RATED capacity (static, from Lakehouse). The maximum the asset CAN produce.
- power_mw (WindTurbine) / power_kw (SolarInverter) / generation_mw (Grid) = ACTUAL CURRENT output (timeseries, from KQL).
- 'current generation' / 'right now' / 'producing now' / 'live output' / 'actual production' -> use the timeseries fields (power_mw / power_kw / generation_mw).
- 'installed capacity' / 'rated capacity' / 'nameplate' / 'maximum capacity' -> use capacity_mw / capacity_kw.
- For wind farm total generation NOW: SUM(WindTurbine.power_mw) latest reading, optionally GROUP BY plant_id.
- For solar park total generation NOW: SUM(SolarInverter.power_kw)/1000 latest reading.

Plant type vs fuel type:
- For 'wind farms' / 'wind plants' -> PowerPlant.plant_type = 'Wind Farm' (NOT 'wind').
- For 'solar parks' -> PowerPlant.plant_type = 'Solar Park'.
- For 'gas plants' / 'fossil' / 'conventional' -> PowerPlant.plant_type = 'Gas Power Plant'.
- For 'renewables' -> plant_type IN ('Wind Farm','Solar Park') OR fuel_type IN ('Wind','Solar').
- Filter on exact enum values from the lists above; do not lowercase the comparison value.


Time and date fields (IMPORTANT):
- EmissionsRecord.period is a STRING in format "YYYY-MM" (e.g. "2026-01", "2026-03"). NOT a datetime. Filter with string operators: period STARTS WITH "2026" for the whole year, period = "2026-03" for one month, period >= "2026-01" AND period <= "2026-12" for a range.
- The current calendar year is 2026. When the user says "this year" interpret as "2026". "Last year" = "2025". "This month" = the current YYYY-MM string.
- WindTurbine / SolarInverter / Grid / Vessel / Emissions live telemetry events have a real datetime column `timestamp` (ZONED_DATETIME). For "now" / "current" / "right now" / "live" use the LATEST timestamp per entity (ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1 per group) or aggregate within the last 1-2 minutes.
- MaintenanceOrder.created_date / scheduled_date / completed_date are ISO dates (date type).
- WindTurbine.commissioning_date / SolarInverter.commissioning_date are ISO dates.
- PowerPlant.commissioning_year is an INTEGER year.
